text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The first day of summer training camp. 
The barbecue grill blazes with roaring 
flames.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I think. Isn't there any way to rekindle 
this flame that's on the verge of going 
out?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you eating properly, I 
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Eat up, okay? If you don't eat, the summer 
heat will get to you, and you won't grow 
big and strong!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Me too... see, look! This is already my 
third one♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's so piping hot and delicious~. Since 
we're here, I think I'll have plenty more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A hearty appetite. Normally, that would be 
something to celebrate. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In Wonder Acute's case, you couldn't 
necessarily say that. It seems she doesn't 
even have the drive to condition her body 
for races anymore.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, is something the matter? Staring 
so intently into the fire like that..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on, our precious barbecue is 
gonna burn! We've gotta eat our fill...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a bite of the barbecue after it was 
offered to me, the flavor was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It tasted a bit too salty.
